verdicts.reason: A: the body copy is broken into four cramped lines that nearly touch the '20% off' headline and run close to the top edge. The product can is tiny and set apart from its peach circle, which is left as an unexplained blob at the far right. The legal text is as big as the body copy. B: the same overstuffed single row, with fine print just as heavy and crowding the right edge. Still, the body copy wraps into three lines with clearer space around it, and the can sits on its circle the way it does in the original, so B looks more intentional, although the circle slightly overlaps the start of the legal text.
